blog.title: The Legacy of Dhakai Jamdani: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage
blog.author: Mrittika Curator
blog.content:
Dhakai Jamdani is not merely a piece of cloth; it is a piece of living history woven on handlooms without any mechanical assistance...

Originating during the Mughal era in Bengal, the sheer cotton muslin Jamdani patterns are drawn directly onto the loom from memory.
